Dog Attacks Injure Multiple Children in Separate Incidents

In Faridabad, Haryana, a pitbull dog attacked a 7th-grade student, biting the child in 16 places on their body, including limbs, while the owner reportedly watched. In a separate incident in Palari, a stray dog attacked more than a dozen children within four hours.
